stories.statement: Expose GET /metrics on the existing HTTP port, rendering the app CollectorRegistry via the Prometheus simpleclient the sibling services use

acceptance_criteria.given: metrics.enabled is true (the default) and the service is running
acceptance_criteria.when: a client sends GET /metrics on the existing HTTP port
acceptance_criteria.then: the response is 200 with a Prometheus text-format body rendered from the app CollectorRegistry

stories.statement: A metrics.enabled toggle, defaulting to true, controls whether the /metrics route exists and whether a real or no-op recorder is used

acceptance_criteria.then: the response includes base JVM metrics from the app CollectorRegistry

acceptance_criteria.given: the app CollectorRegistry holds the registered collectors
acceptance_criteria.then: the response is in the Prometheus text exposition format

stories.statement: The exposed registry includes base JVM metrics alongside worker metrics

epics.title: Operator can observe worker throughput and health through MetricsRecorder-backed metrics

stories.statement: The MetricsRecorder seam injected into the JobConsumer records jobs processed by lane and outcome

acceptance_criteria.given: the JobConsumer processes a job in a given lane and the job completes successfully
acceptance_criteria.then: MetricsRecorder increments a jobs-processed counter labeled with that lane and outcome=success

acceptance_criteria.given: the JobConsumer processes a job in a given lane and the job fails
acceptance_criteria.then: MetricsRecorder increments a jobs-processed counter labeled with that lane and outcome=failure

stories.statement: The MetricsRecorder seam records job processing time in a histogram

acceptance_criteria.then: MetricsRecorder records the elapsed processing time as an observation in a processing-time histogram

stories.statement: The MetricsRecorder seam tracks the number of jobs currently in flight via a gauge
